notes.title: Update v1.1.11 – Visual Overhaul, Balance Tweaks, and QoL Fixes
notes.content:
This one’s all about cleanup. updated a bunch of visuals, smoothed out some systems, and made the game a bit more readable and forgiving in the right places. It’s not a huge content drop, but it should make every run feel better.

Here’s what’s new:

Gameplay & Balance

Final biome difficulty reduced to smooth out the endgame curve.

Max spawners per mission reduced to 4 for better pacing.

Wave spawning improved for more consistent encounters.

Health Regen buffed, with additional upgrade levels available.

Emergency Repair cost adjusted for easier purchase in the early game.

Wall mana costs rebalanced to support more terrain interaction.

First map nodes will no longer spawn as Elite encounters.

Visuals & UI Improvements

All Core, Tower, and Spell icons updated with new visuals.

All Upgrade and Currency icons updated with new visuals.

Arcane Forge UI overhauled for better readability.

Map Info Panel improved to highlight rewards and encounters.

Renamed Rewards:

Core Charger ➜ Repair Kit

Core Shield ➜ Vitality

Core placement and cleanse effects enhanced with improved visuals and feedback.

Health bar now shows yellow for damage taken and green for healing received.

Interactable rewards now show a clear "claimed" effect when activated.

Bug Fixes

Fixed rare voxel rendering race conditions.

Fixed terrain rendering bugs causing visual inconsistencies.

Fixed player movement during the Map Room tutorial.



Thanks for playing and for all the feedback lately. More updates are coming, but in the meantime, I hope this one smooths out your next few runs.

notes.title: Tutorial Update + Small Balance Tweaks
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Today’s update brings a more intuitive and helpful tutorial system to Stop the Blight, along with a few small balance adjustments.

The new tutorial is designed to make things easier to learn without slowing you down. It now includes short video previews, shows input bindings for both mouse+keyboard and gamepad users, and gives clearer explanations for walls. Since building efficient paths is a key part of the game’s strategy.

Tutorial Improvements:

 Reworked tutorial flow to feel more intuitive
 Short video clips added to show what each mechanic looks like
 Displays correct input bindings for both mouse/keyboard and gamepad
 Improved clarity around how walls work and why they matter
 The old tutorial used the same dialog system as story/lore text, which caused some players to skip it thinking it wasn’t important. The new system is separate from dialog and visually distinct, so it’s easier to recognize and follow


Balance Adjustments:

 Slightly increased the movement speed for all enemies
 Reduced damage from terraforming spells from 18 -> 8 (raising, lowering, and leveling terrain spells are intended to be support instead of damage spells)


This is part of a larger effort to improve onboarding and help new players understand the game’s core systems right away. As always, thanks for playing and sharing your feedback. If you have ideas, questions, or just want to hang out, come join us on Discord.

notes.title: The Demo is Back – With a Balance Pass!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
The demo for Stop the Blight is now available again! It’s been brought up to date with the current version of the game, so if you’ve been waiting to check it out (or want to see how much has changed since the original demo), now’s a great time.

This update also includes a balance pass aimed at increasing the challenge during a run. The Blight spreads faster, towers are under more pressure, and a few spells have been re-tuned.

Enhancements

 Cores now break into tiny pieces when destroyed
 Holy Hand Grenade now clears blight on explosion

Balance Changes (Increased Run Difficulty)

 Portals are now invulnerable
 Slightly reduced mana cost for all wall types
 Blight damage to towers increased: 10 → 18 per tick
 Blight growth increased: 100 → 192 per tick (every 3 seconds)
 Rejuvenate spell rate of fire reduced: 1s → 2s
 Daybreak Cannon direct damage reduced from 24 -> 22
 Sunbeam Spire:

 Starting DPS reduced: 10 → 8
 Damage ramping reduced: +1/s → +0.5/s
 Max damage reduced: 20 → 16
 (Now deals 8 DPS at start, 16 DPS after 16s on target)

 Blight Purifier:

 Mana cost reduced: 32 → 28
 Blight clearing radius increased
 Healing amounts reduced: 16 → 12, 20 → 15, 24 → 18



This is part of an ongoing effort to fine-tune balance and push the strategic side of the game even further. Thanks to everyone who’s been offering feedback and reporting bugs, it’s been incredibly helpful.

As always, feel free to jump into the Discord to share your thoughts or just hang out with the community.

notes.title: Stop the Blight is out now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
I'm incredibly excited (and a little nervous!) to announce that Stop the Blight is officially released!

This has been my passion project for a long time. While I built most of it solo, I had help from some amazing freelancers who contributed 3D models, artwork, and music. Their talent really helped bring the world to life.

The game is a tactical tower defense roguelite built around spellcasting, terrain manipulation, and elemental strategy—and now it’s in your hands.

That said, this is just the beginning. There's still more I want to add and improve, and your feedback will help shape where things go next. Here's what's planned for post-launch:


 Steam achievements
 Improved sound effects and possibly more music
 Storyline completion with character dialog and lore snippets
 More permanent upgrades, more runes, and more strategic depth


If you've been following the project—thank you. And if you're just discovering it now, welcome! I hope you enjoy playing as much as I’ve enjoyed building it.

Please feel free to join the community, share your thoughts, and help me make this game even better. Your support makes everything possible.

Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/gQbn2t5Yfy
